documents.untrustedSourceText:
<!-- PageHeader: Claim: ARC-26-739979 -->
<!-- PageHeader: Statement Date: 06/13/2026 -->

On 06/12/2026 at about 4:18PM, I was at Juniper
Center in Aspen Hollow for a short appointment . I parked
in the uncovered lot on the south side of the building.
Within a few minutes, a strong storm moved in with
heavy rain and hail.

I stayed indoors until the storm passed. When I returned
to my vehicle, I noticed small dents across the hood,
roof and on the upper panels of the left side. The left
front fender and the upper portions of the left doors
have the most visible marks. The glass (windshield,
windows and rear glass) appears to be intact.

There was no contact with any other vehicle or object
to my knowledge. No one else was involved and the
police were not called.

I started the vehicle and it ran normally. The vehicle
remained drivable after the storm on 06/12/2026.
I drove home without issue.

I am reporting hail damage only. No injuries.
Photos were taken at the scene and at home.

This account is true to the best of my knowledge.

Sincerely,
M.C.

Marcus Coleman

<!-- PageBreak -->
